newsitem.title: JAPAN: September JGBs seen rising to 123.00.
newsitem.headline: September JGBs seen rising to 123.00.

text.p: The key September Japanese government bond (JGB) futures contract is likely to reach 123.00 on Thursday on continued bullish sentiment from Wednesday.
Wednesday's Tokyo finish was 122.74. But the September advanced further on LIFFE to close at 122.84.
"Since a chart resistance of 122.84 was cleared in London, the contract may rise to and above 123.00 today," said a market analyst at a city bank's securities unit said.
The contract may fluctuate widely on dealers' speculative activities amid a lack of investor participation, traders said.
"Activity would be led by dealers who had built many unfavourable positions before the June JGB futures options expired at the end of May," a dealer at a local securities house said.
Investors mostly refrained from trading this week. They are expected to do so until the Bank of Japan (BOJ) releases its "tankan" corporate survey on June 25, he said.
Focus is also on whether the key Nikkei-225 stock average can rise above 21,000, traders said.
The Ministry of Finance is expected to auction 1.3 trillion yen worth of six-month Treasury bills today, they said.
